implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired confirmatory protocol using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter. Use the hosted LLM API (gpt-5-mini) for all generation and repair calls. For guarded condition apply the registered generate_validate_repair_v1 transformation: the pipeline invokes a single initial generation (shared candidate) then at most one repair prompt to the same hosted model when deterministic validator fails. Deterministic reachability validation and emulation run in Docker containers (pybatfish-like deterministic validator and Mininet + containerized router images) on CPU hosts; no Kubernetes. All scoring is automated: deterministic validator compares intended reachability specification to emulation traces and outputs binary pass/fail per episode. All selection, contamination checks, augmentation, retries, logging, and hashing are automated. No human annotation or adjudication is used.
task_manifest_strategy: Automated harvest from public NetOps corpora + deterministic contamination filters (exact-string, k=8-token shingle Jaccard, token-overlap heuristics) with deterministic synthetic-template supplementation to reach N=300; fixed RNG seed for stratified draw; all decisions logged.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Intent normalization (deterministic schema mapping) -> baseline direct_configuration_generation_v1 using single gpt-5-mini call; guarded generate_validate_repair_v1: initial gpt-5-mini generation, deterministic validator run in Docker, if validator fails produce one repair prompt to gpt-5-mini, then validator re-run; config post-processing includes syntax sanitizer and vendor mapping; automatic rejection rules implemented in code.
randomisation_plan: Fixed RNG seed (preregistered) used for stratified sampling by intent-complexity strata (simple/medium/complex). No additional randomisation during generation sematics (shared_initial_candidate determinism preserved via single-sample generation per call).
caching_plan: Cache all model responses, validator verdicts, emulation traces, parser/AST artifacts, and transformation outputs with content-addressed hashes. Reuse cached model responses for deterministic replays. Do not cache across experiments with different seeds or prompt versions.
failure_recovery_plan: Automated retry policy: up to 2 retries for transient API/container startup failures with exponential backoff; after retries mark pair as technical failure and exclude under primary 'complete_pair_primary' analysis. All failures, retry attempts, timestamps, and hashes logged. No human remediation.
result_schema: Episode-level paired binary outcome per intent: for each intent produce baseline episode and guarded episode. Each episode record includes model-call logs (prompts/responses), validator verdict (pass/fail), emulation trace, deterministic success flag (1/0), and failure-mode code. Primary per-intent outcome = 1 if guarded episode final config execution-validated and has no unintended reachability changes; baseline outcome analogous. Scoring deterministic and automated.
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call budget: estimated 450 hosted LLM calls (≈300 initial + ≈150 repair calls at assumed 50% repair rate). Maximum planned hosted LLM calls = 600 (300 tasks * 2 calls). Dockerized validators and Mininet emulations run on available CPU nodes; expected CPU-hours: validator unit checks ~0.5 CPU-min per run, emulation per episode ~2–4 CPU-min; approximate total CPU time across 600 episodes ≈ 900–1500 CPU-min (15–25 CPU-hours). Wall-clock execution scheduled in 6 parallel batches; expected wall time < 48 hours under available CPU parallelism and hosted-model latency assumptions. All compute estimates fit capability manifest limits (no local GPU required).
